reviews.review: I first played Roboquest in closed alpha few months ago, didn't liked it much...[list][/list]Just received a key from the devs, i was hesitant at first but holy ♥♥♥♥ i'm glad i gave it another try ! [code][h1]The game have evolved and improved so much, it's way better than since i last played it.[/h1][/code][list][/list]Edit: Added some gameplay.[list][/list]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v_VBdehccxs [list][/list]The gameplay is really good, it's very fast paced and satisfying !To be honest the guns feels just as satisfying as Borderlands 3 if not better.The comparison with BL ends with the graphics and artstyle because Roboquest is a rogue lite.[list][/list]The graphics looks great with a nice cell shading effect, music is really cool and fits the action perfectly.Super smooth movements, ultra fast weapons switching and responsive controls, nice and snappy.[list][/list]Overall it's pretty amazing to play, really fun and fast paced, exactly what i love.[code][h1]Well done RyseUp Studios, can't wait to see how the game will evolve ![/h1][/code]If you like fps games mixed with rogue lite elements definitely give this one a shot, it's really good, well worth it.[list][/list][spoiler]ps: steam review formatting is broken atm, that's why my review looks weird, had to improvise lol[/spoiler] [hr][/hr]This review will be edited as more updates and improvements are made into the game.[h1]Early access build 0.1.1-112 rating 8/10.[/h1]

This game is amazing, but word of advice wait a bit on the buy because right now it is very very short. 
Depending on how good you are or how lucky you can finish it in 3h or less easily.
Really fun, light and well thought-out shooter, it is charming.

Mister DOOM meets this nice girl Miss BORDERLANDS and guess what.... 
Baby ROBOQUEST is born.

Thats the best way to explain what this is.
Great game so far, looking forward what the future brings.

GREAT GAME: the new update added some spice to the game play with the new class and some tweaks to the other classes i feel this is a game that when it comes to the full release will be a great and diverse game
